Sun gano cewa marasa lafiya da ke dauke da HBV kawai suna da ƙarancin yiwuwar samun magani na rigakafin cututtukan ƙwayoyin cuta, suna nuna alamun cututtukan hanta na halitta (tunda HBV ƙwayar cuta ce da ke iya haifar da mummunan cutar hanta).

Masu binciken sun iya nuna cewa mutanen da ke dauke da HBV kawai suna da rashin amfani idan aka kwatanta da wadanda ke dauke da HIV da HBV duka, domin marasa lafiya da suka kamu da kwayoyin cutar biyu suna iya samun maganin rigakafin HIV, wanda kuma yana da amfani wajen yakar kamuwa da cutar HBV.

Sakamakon wannan bincike ya haskaka yuwuwar tasirin bambance-bambancen tsakanin hanyoyin tura marasa lafiya, kula da su, da kuma maganin cutar hanta ta HBV idan aka kwatanta da cutar HIV da kuma hadin cutar HBV, wanda ya fi amfani ga wadanda suka kamu da cutar HIV da HBV duka biyu.
Masu binciken sun jaddada cewa dole ne mu inganta kuma mu samar da sabis mai aminci da adalci ga marasa lafiya da ke dauke da cutar HBV kawai.
Gurguzu ɗaya na wannan bincike shine ƙarancin yawan jama'a da aka yi amfani da su wanda ya shafi ƙasa ɗaya da tsarin asibitoci na ƙasar kawai.
Wasu, watakila ma'aikatun asibiti masu ci gaba, na iya nuna ra'ayi daban idan aka kwatanta da abin da aka samu a wannan binciken.
Za a buƙaci yin ƙarin bincike don gano bambance-bambancen da aka samu a wannan binciken a zahiri.
Wannan takarda ta nuna ƙarfin hadin gwiwa, inda masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu da Birtaniya suka yi aiki tare a wannan aiki.
Ta hanyar amfani da marasa lafiya na Afirka ta Kudu a wannan bincike, yana da muhimmanci ga wani ɓangare na al'ummar Afirka.
Bugu da ƙari, binciken na iya taimakawa wajen samar da mafi kyawun tsare-tsaren magani ga waɗanda ke fama da HBV, HIV ko duka biyu.
Kimanta Tasiririn Rashin Tsaro Akan Ayyukan Kasuwancin Mata a Karamar Hukumar Shiroro Ta Jihar Neja

Wannan binciken ya bincika tasirin rashin tsaro kan ayyukan kasuwanci na mata a Karamar Hukumar Shiroro ta Jihar Neja, inda ya mayar da hankali musamman kan batutuwan dogaro da kuɗi na mata, irin ayyukan kasuwanci da suka zama ruwan dare a tsakaninsu da kuma girman tasirin rashin tsaro kan ƙoƙarinsu na kasuwanci.

An yi bincike ga samfurin mata 377, wanda ya haifar da samun cewa mata a Shiroro suna da kishin kasuwanci sosai tare da matsayin ‘yancin kai na kudi mai girma, inda suka fi mayar da hankali kan kananan da matsakaiciyar sana’o’i (SMEs).

Nazarin ya kuma gano cewa yayin da rashin tsaro ke da mummunan tasiri ga ayyukan kasuwancin mata a matsayin asarar ko raguwar jari da sauran abubuwa, adadin mata masu kasuwanci bai samu raguwa mai yawa ba.

Nazarin ya bada shawara cewa ya kamata a kirkiro shirye-shiryen dorewa domin inganta samun mata da amfani da ayyukan kudi, kuma ya kamata a kirkiro da kuma ƙarfafa kungiyoyin ‘yan sanda na al’umma domin yakar rashin tsaro a yankin da aka gudanar da binciken.
'Yan kasuwa mata a Nijar na bukatar ƙarin tsaro.
Masu bincike sun gano cewa mata masu kasuwanci a Nijar suna da ƙwazo sosai kuma suna da ‘yancin kai a fannin kuɗi, amma aminci daga masu laifi matsala ce.
Masu bincike sun so sanin matakin aminci da tsaro na mata masu kasuwanci a Karamar Hukumar Shiroro ta Jihar Neja, da kuma yadda hakan zai iya shafar kasuwancinsu da kuma ‘yancin tattalin arzikinsu.
Sun yi hira da mata 377 a wannan yankin game da kalubalen da suke fuskanta dangane da ayyukan kasuwancinsu, dogaro da kuɗi da rashin tsaro.
Sun ruwaito cewa kashi 43% na matan sun ce ba sa dogaro da maza don kuɗi, kuma kashi 32% sun ce akwai wasu mutane da ke dogaro da su don kuɗi.
Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa kashi 85% na matan suna samun kuɗi daga kasuwanci daban-daban, kuma kaɗan ne kawai suka ce sun dogara da albashi.
Kimanin kashi 56% sun samu kuɗi ta hanyar noma, kuma kashi 79% ta hanyar ciniki.
Kimanin mace 1 daga cikin mata 5 ta samu kuɗi ta hanyar ɗaure gashi, sawa, saka ko yin wanke-wanke.
Yawancin mata (91%) sun shaida wa masu bincike cewa harkokinsu sun shafa sakamakon tsoron kai hare-hare daga masu satar kaya da miyagu.
Sun rasa kuɗi, har ma da mazajensu sakamakon waɗannan hare-haren, wanda hakan yana tilasta musu kula da 'ya'yansu su kaɗai.
Matan kuma sun ce basu da isassun ƙwarewa da kuɗi don fadada kasuwancinsu.
Masu binciken sun rawaito cewa duk da kalubalen, matan Nijar sun ci gaba da yin nasara sosai a harkokinsu.
Sun ce Shiroro na da mutane daga kabilu da addinai daban-daban, kuma wannan yana da kyau ga kasuwanci.
Wannan binciken yana ƙalubalantar binciken masu bincike da suka gabata waɗanda suka bayar da rahoton cewa mata ba sa samun nasara a kasuwanci saboda kula da gidajensu.
Amma, waɗannan masu binciken sun ce nasarar mata 'yan kasuwa a wannan yankin Nijar ta fi shafawa ta hanyar barazanar hare-haren masu laifi da masu sata.
Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar cewa duk masu ruwa da tsaki ya kamata su hadu su yi yaƙi da abubuwan da za su iya sa samun nasara a kasuwanci ya zama da wuya.
Alal misali, ya kamata mata a Nijar su samu damar samun kuɗi, gonaki da kuma aminci sosai.
Sun kuma bayar da shawara cewa mata masu kasuwanci za su iya kafa kungiyoyi da za su taimaka musu wajen yakar masu satar da miyagu.
Matakan Selenium, Tagulla da Zinc a Jinin Uwa a Lokacin Daukar Ciki Sun Shafi Hadarin Haihuwar Ƙuruciya Ba Tare Da Dalili Ba: Nazarin Misali da Kwatanta daga Malawi
Haihuwar da ta yi wuri ita ce haihuwar da ta faru kafin makonni 37 cikakke.
An gudanar da bincike domin tantance alaƙar tsakanin matakan sinadarin selenium, tagulla, da zinc a jinin uwa da haihuwar ɓangare.
Akwai mata 181 a wannan binciken na nazari na shari’a da iko, 90/181 (49.7%) cikakkun lokaci da 91/181 (50.3%) mata masu juna biyu da ba a kai lokaci ba.

Matsakaicin matsakaicin maidaurin sinadarin selenium a jini shine 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, jan karfe shine 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L da kuma sinadarin zinc shine 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L tare da ƙimar da aka ambata ta 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L da 0.59-1.11 mg/L, bi da bi.
Sakamakon ya nuna cewa babu karancin selenium da zinc; kuma akwai yawan sinadarin jan karfe a jinin mata masu juna biyu.
Haihuwar da ta yi wuri ta shafi ƙaruwar sinadarin jan karfe da zinc a jinin uwa.
Matakan Zinc, tagulla, da selenium da suka shafi haihuwar da wuri.

Masu bincike sun gano yawan sinadarai masu mahimmanci kamar selenium, tagulla, da zinc, a jikin mata da suka yi haihuwa kafin lokaci, amma har yanzu ba su san ko wannan yawan ya fito ne daga abincin da suke ci ba.
Haihuwar da ta yi wuri tana faruwa ne lokacin da mace ta haifi jariri kafin ta cika makonni 37 na daukar ciki.
Haihuwar da ta yi wuri tana da alaƙa da sakamakon lafiya mara kyau ga jariri, daga nakasu har zuwa mutuwa.
Akwai dalilai da dama da ke haifar da haihuwar da wuri, amma rawar da yawan sinadarai masu mahimmanci da ake samu a abinci da muhalli ke takawa ba a san shi sosai ba.
Waɗannan ƙwayoyin abinci masu ƙanƙanta suna da muhimmanci ga ci gaban jariri, amma masu bincike suna son sanin abin da ke faruwa idan sun yi yawa.

A wannan bincike, masu bincike sun yi niyyar auna yawan selenium, tagulla, da zinc a jikin mata da suka yi haihuwa kafin lokaci, sannan su tantance yiwuwar haihuwar da aka yi kafin lokaci ta hanyar yawan kowane sinadarin abinci mai mahimmanci da aka yi nazari a kai.
Masu binciken sun tattara samfurin jinin mata 181 nan da nan bayan sun haihu a asibitoci biyu a Lilongwe, babban birnin Malawi, tsakanin watan Yuni 2016 zuwa Maris 2017.
Sun tura samfuran jinin zuwa dakin gwaje-gwaje a Norway inda suka fitar da sinadarin jini, wanda shi ne nau’in jini mai tsabta, sannan suka auna yawan selenium, tagulla da zinc.
Kimanin rabin mata 181 da aka yi nazari a kansu sun haifi ‘ya’yansu kafin lokaci, kuma masu binciken sun gano yawan sinadarin selenium, tagulla da zinc sosai.

Sai suka daidaita lissafinsu domin su yi la’akari da sauran abubuwa da dama kamar shekaru, lafiyar jiki gaba ɗaya, da tarihin daukar ciki domin su gano illolin da ake zargin sinadarai masu ƙarfi ke haifarwa na haihuwar jarirai kafin lokaci.

Sun ƙarasa da cewa yawan sinadarin selenium da jan karfe ba su taka rawa mai muhimmanci ba wajen haifar da haihuwar da wuri, amma yawan sinadarin zinc ya ƙara haɗarin haihuwar da wuri sau shida fiye da haka.
Duk da haka, yawan jan karfe da yawa ya zama abin damuwa ga masu bincike, saboda illolin da aka sani.

Kasancewar mata 181 ne kawai suka shiga binciken ya iyakance damar masu binciken wajen gano haɗarin da ke tattare da matakan selenium mai yawa yadda ya kamata, domin adadin mahalarta da ya dace shine 600.
Ba a bincika abincin yau da kullun na mahalarta ba don nemo yuwuwar tushen sinadarai guda uku masu ƙarfi, kuma ba a rubuta Ma'aunin Nauyin Jiki (BMI) na su ba.
Wannan shi ne binciken farko na irin sa da ya auna tasirin selenium, tagulla da zinc a mata masu juna biyu a Malawi.

Afirka na da wasu daga cikin mafi girman matakan haihuwar jarirai kafin lokaci - sama da kashi 18% idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashen Yammacin duniya da ke da kashi 5%, don haka masu bincike suna son sanin ko abinci mai gina jiki yana da rawa.
Halin Komawa Gida, Amincewa da Wuri, da Yankin Mulki na Kwaton Kasko (Malacochersus tornieri) a Kenya
Dabbobi suna nuna halayen sarari da lokaci na musamman waɗanda ke inganta rayuwarsu.
Gane irin waɗannan halayya mataki ne mai muhimmanci wajen kulawa da sarrafawa ingantacce, musamman na nau'ikan da ke cikin haɗari.

A wannan binciken, mun gwada ko kurmi na irin Pancake yana da ikon komawa gida idan aka mayar da shi wuri daban, kuma mun bincika amincin wurin zama da yankin mallakar wannan nau’in a wuraren zama na halitta a gundumar Kitui, Kenya.

An yi nazari kan halayyar zakuna 39 da ke zaune a cikin ramuka masu faɗi 12 da ke faɗaɗɗe daga watan Yuli 2020 zuwa Yuni 2022 ta hanyar bin diddigin rediyo, kama da kyamara da haɗa samfurin bincike na ƙungiya da kuma samfurin ad libitum.

An saka na'urorin watsa rediyo a kan kwatangwalo goma sha huɗu, kuma an mayar da su daga ramuka masu zaman kansu zuwa wasu ramuka masu nisa daga ramuka masu zaman kansu, sannan aka bibiyi motsinsu da halayensu.

Banda mata biyu kawai da suka dace sosai da sabbin ramuka da aka mayar da su, sauran kurajen duka sun ƙoƙarta komawa gidajensu, inda kashi 46.15% daga cikinsu suka gano hanyarsu ta komawa rumfunansu na gida daidai gwargwado, kuma kashi 15.38% kuma sun isa wurare da ake ganin suna cikin yankin gidajensu.
Nasarar dawowa gida ba shakka tana nuna amincin wurin zama sosai a wannan nau'in halitta.

Binciken da aka yi game da yawan ƙwaƙwalwar ƙwai ya nuna cewa babu bambanci mai ma'ana a tsakanin adadin ƙwaƙwalwar da ke nan a farko a cikin ƙwaƙwalwar da matsakaicin adadin da ke nan a cikin kwanaki 162 na samfurori (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P > 0.05), wanda hakan ya ƙara tabbatar da amincin wurin zama a cikin wannan nau'in.
A gefe guda kuma, bin diddigin kyamarar da kuma samfurin ad libitum sun kuma tabbatar da cewa kurma na Pancake suna da yankinsu, inda maza ke kare yankunansu da ƙarfi daga sauran mazan da ke shigowa.
Kunkuru masu kewayawa da suka ɓace suna da ikon ban mamaki na ‘samun gida’.

Masu bincike sun sami mamaki yayin da suke nazari kan halayyar kurmi masu faffadan ƙafafun Gabashin Afirka (Malacochersus tornieri): dabbobi na iya samun hanyarsu ta koma gida bayan an motsa su a nesa.
Fahimtar yadda da dalilin da suka yi hakan na iya zama muhimmi ga kiyaye waɗannan kwararan dabbobi masu rarrafe.
Hanyoyin nemo gida da waɗannan zakuna ke nunawa ana kiransa “nemo gida”, kuma sauran dabbobi da yawa ma suna iya yin hakan.
Samun damar komawa wurare na musamman yana ba da damar dabbobi su dawo ga abinci, abokan aure, da mafaka, wanda hakan ke inganta damar su ta rayuwa da haihuwa.

Ko da yake an yi nazari sosai kan halin dawowa gida a cikin kunkuru na teku da na ruwan sha, masu binciken a wannan nazari sun ce har yanzu ba mu san da yawa ba game da dawowa gida a cikin kurma (na ƙasa masu kama da kunkuru).
A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su fahimci halayen zakaran kwanon rufi a mazauninsu na halitta a tsaunukan dutse na Kenya.
Sun yi nazari kan dabbobi yayin da suke motsawa da ci, kuma lokacin da suka je hutawa a ramuka, ko gibba a dutse.
Masu binciken sun lura da rukunin kunkuru masu siffar kek ɗin kusan shekaru biyu, kuma sun sanya kyamarori don yin rikodin bidiyon dabbobi lokacin da ba su kallonsu ba.
Sun kuma ɗaura na'urorin watsa rediyo a kan kurame guda 14.
Wadannan na’urori ne ƙanana waɗanda ke ba masu bincike damar bibiyar motsin dabbobi, da kuma sa ido kan inda suke kashe lokacinsu a rana da dare.
Sannan masu binciken suka ɗauki wasu daga cikin kurajen da aka bibiya zuwa wani wuri, domin su iya nazari a kan su cikin sauƙi.
Amma abin mamaki ga masu binciken, biyu daga cikin zakuna suka fara komawa yankunansu na asali, tsakanin kilomita 1 zuwa 2.5 daga inda aka mayar da su.
Shi ne lokacin da masu binciken suka yanke shawarar gwada motsa ƙarin dabbobi daga gidajensu, don ganin ko za su nuna irin wannan halayyar ‘komawa gida’.
Abin mamaki, kusan rabin kunkuru sun iya samun hanyarsu zuwa ga  gidajen da suke zaune a cikinsu kafin a motsa su, sau da yawa suna tafiya sama da kilomita 1.5 don zuwa can.
Wasu kashi 15% kuma sun iya dawowa yankin, amma ba su iya samun ramin da aka ɗauke su daga ciki ba.
Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa ramuka daban-daban yawanci suna da adadin kurame iri ɗaya da ke hutawa a cikinsu, wanda ke nuna cewa kuramen suna amfani da wurare iri ɗaya don hutawa.
Hoton da aka dauka daga kyamarori ya kuma nuna cewa zakaran kwatangwalo masu namiji suna da yankinsu, ma’ana zasu yi fada da wasu maza da ke kokarin shiga yankinsu ko kuma rami.

Masu binciken sun ce wannan shi ne karo na farko da aka ga halin komawa gida a cikin kunkuru masu faffada, kuma sakamakon bincikensu ya nuna cewa waɗannan dabbobi suna son zama da hutawa a wurare ɗaya duk lokacin da za su iya.
Bincikensu bai bayyana yadda zakuna ke samun hanyarsu ta gida ba, don haka bincike na gaba ya kamata ya mayar da hankali kan fahimtar wannan muhimmiyar magana.
Domin wasu lokutan ana buƙatar motsa dabbobi zuwa sabbin wurare domin kare su, wannan bayani zai taimaka wa masu kare muhalli wajen kiyaye kwari a amince a sabon muhalli.
Nazarin hadin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya daga Kenya da China, kuma ya ƙara wa iliminmu game da halayyar komawa gida a cikin zakuna da sauran dabbobi.
Kimiyyar Magunguna a Jinin Plasma na Babban Matsayi na Maganin Baki da na Jijiya na Rifampicin ga Marasa Lafiya da ke dauke da Kumburi na Kwatsa:
Gwajin Sarrafawa da aka Yi Ta Wasu Hanyoyi
Hanyoyin maganin rifampicin da aka saka a jijiya masu yawa na iya inganta sakamako a cutar meningitis ta tarin fuka, amma ba shi da amfani a wuraren da cutar ta yadu sosai.

Mun yi zato cewa bayyanar rifampicin a cikin jinin zata kasance iri daya tsakanin shan maganin ta baki na 35 mg/kg na nauyin jiki da kuma allurar maganin ta jijiya na 20 mg/kg, wanda aka gabatar don gwajin inganci a cutar meningitis ta kuturta.
Mun gudanar da binciken sinadarai na jiki na ƙungiyar da aka raba ta hanyar raba-raba wanda aka saka a cikin gwajin asibiti na maganin ƙwayoyin cuta mai ƙarfi don meningitis na cutar sankarau.
An dauki mahalarta masu dauke da cutar HIV wadanda ke dauke da cutar sankarau ta kwakwalwa daga asibitoci a Afirka ta Kudu kuma aka raba su zuwa kungiyoyi uku na shan maganin rifampicin:
na al'ada (ta baki 10 mg/kg),  babban kashi (ta baki 35 mg/kg), da kuma allurar jini (20 mg/kg).
An yi samfurin sinadarai mai zurfi a rana ta uku.
An bayyana bayanai ta amfani da binciken da ba a raba shi ba, kuma an kwatanta abubuwan da aka gani ta hanyar ƙididdigar matsakaicin lissafi (GMRs).
Masu shiga guda arba’in da shida sun yi gwajin sinadarai (ma’aunin al’ada, n = 17; ma’aunin baki mai yawa, n = 15; na jijiya, n = 14).
Matsakaicin ƙididdigar CD4 shine kwayoyin 130/mm3 (kewayon tsakanin ƙididdiga [IQR], 66 zuwa 253 kwayoyin/mm3).

Darajojin matsakaicin yankin rifampicin da aka samu a ƙarƙashin laƙabin lokaci daga 0 zuwa awanni 24 (AUC0–24) sune 42.9mg · h/ml (kashi 95% na amincewa [CI], 24.5 zuwa 75.0mg ·h/ml) ga ma'aunin al'ada, 295.2mg · h/ml (kashi 95% CI, 189.9 zuwa 458.8mg · h/ml) ga babban ma'aunin baki, da kuma 206.5mg · h/ml (kashi 95% CI, 154.6 zuwa 275.8mg · h/ml) ga allurar jini.

Darajar AUC0–24 GMR na rifampicin ita ce 1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 zuwa 2.21) kuma mafi girman yawan maganin a cikin jini (Cmax) GMR shi ne 0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 zuwa 1.23) ga shan maganin baki mai yawa idan aka kwatanta da allurar jini.
Yawancin plasma rifampicin AUC0–24 ya yi yawa bayan shan maganin baki na 35-mg/kg fiye da allurar jini a kashi 20-mg/kg a cikin kwanaki kaɗan na farko na maganin cutar sankarau (TB).
Sakamakon ya goyi bayan shan maganin rifampicin ta baki a gwajin cutar sankarau ta kwakwalwa na gaba.
Ana iya gwada magunguna masu ƙarfi a kan marasa lafiyar HIV da ke fama da cutar sankarau ta kwakwalwa.
Masu bincike sun tabbatar da cewa yana da kyau a fara gwada ko manyan magungunan rifampicin za su iya ceto marasa lafiyar HIV da ke fama da cutar sankarau ta kwakwalwa.
Har zuwa 3 daga cikin kowane marasa lafiyar HIV 5 da suka kamu da cutar sankarau ta kwakwalwa suna mutuwa saboda wannan cuta, wacce ke kai wa tsarin jijiyoyin jiki hari.
Yawancin waɗanda suka tsira suna da lalacewar dindindin a tsarin juyayin tsakiya da muhimman jijiyoyin da ke fita daga kwakwalwa.
Wannan na iya shafar motsin zuciyarsu da motsinsu.
Wasu marasa lafiya suna fama da fitsari ko bugun jini, ko kuma wasu ɓangarori na fuska ko jikinsu suka yi nakasu.
Rifampicin, ƙarfin maganin rigakafi da ake amfani da shi wajen yakar cutar tarin fuka, ana bawa marasa lafiya a matsayin kwayoyi domin kashe ƙwayoyin cuta masu haifar da kumburi a kwakwalwa.
Marasa lafiya masu matsanancin rashin lafiya akai-akai suna samun matsala wajen hadiye magunguna.
Ana iya baiwa Rifampicin ta hanyar allurar jini (a cikin jijiyoyi) a matsayin ruwa.
Sai a saka allura a cikin jijiyar maraƙin don a iya sakin ruwan a jikinsa.
Har yanzu ba a yi gwaje-gwaje ba don gano yadda jikin mai haƙuri ke ɗaukar magani idan aka yi amfani da wannan hanya.
Maganin allurar jijiya yana buƙatar ƙarin kayan aiki, kwantar da mara lafiya a asibiti da kuma ma’aikacin kiwon lafiya mai horo wanda ya san yadda za a saka allurar jijiya yadda ya kamata.
Don haka, ba lallai bane zaɓi a yankunan da ke fama da karancin albarkatu a duniya.
Likitoci sun riga sun sani cewa jikin bai dauki rifampicin sosai ba a cikin ruwan kwakwalwa, kashin baya da kwanyar, wanda shi ne inda kwayoyin cuta zasu iya ɓuya.
Shi ya sa ake buƙatar allurai masu yawa (na adadi) don kashe dukkan ƙwayoyin cuta a jikin mai haƙuri yadda ya kamata.
Amma masu bincike ba su tabbata yawan maganin da zai iya zama mai tasiri kuma lafiya ba.

Don haka, masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu da Birtaniya sun so su gano, ta amfani da ƙananan marasa lafiya, ko yana da aminci a ba da allurai masu yawa na rifampicin ko dai a matsayin capsules ko kuma ta hanyar allurar jini, da kuma yadda jikinsu zai karɓi kowace sigar.
Wannan abu ne mai muhimmanci a sani kafin sauran masu bincike su fara gwaje-gwaje masu girma, ko kuma gwaje-gwaje, inda suke shirin baiwa marasa lafiya da yawa allurai masu yawa na rifampicin.
An bai wa marasa lafiya masu kamuwa da cutar HIV guda 46 na Afirka ta Kudu, wadanda ke dauke da cutar sankarau a kwakwalwa, daya daga cikin nau'ikan maganin rifampicin guda uku.
Na farko shi ne maganin al'ada na kwayoyi da ake baiwa marasa lafiya a halin yanzu, wanda ya kai 10mg na rifampicin ga kowace kilogiram da marasa lafiyar ke nauyi.
Wani rukuni kuma sun karɓi allunan maganin mai yawa na miligram 35 a kowace kilogiram na nauyin marasa lafiya.
Kungiya ta uku ta karɓi maganin ta hanyar jijiya, milligram 20 a kowace kilogram na nauyin mutum.
An ɗauki samfurin jini daga marasa lafiya bayan kwana uku.
Bayan haka, masu binciken suka auna yawan rifampicin da ke cikin jinin su (ruwan jini).
An samu ƙarin rifampicin a jikin marasa lafiya da suka karɓi allunan maganin da ke da yawa fiye da waɗanda suka karɓi maganin ta hanyar allurar jini ko kuma maganin da aka saba amfani da shi.
Yawan maganin a cikin jinin jini iri ɗaya ne ga maganin ƙarfi da maganin jijiya.
Wadannan matakan sun yi yawa fiye da lokacin da marasa lafiya suka karɓi maganin yau da kullun kawai.

A cewar masu binciken, wannan yana nuna cewa lafiyar marasa lafiya da ke fama da kumburi na kwakwalwa sakamakon cutar tarin fuka yana iya inganta idan suka karɓi maganin rifampicin a ma'auni mafi girma.
Ba komai ne idan sun karɓi maganin ta hanyar allurai ko ta hanyar jijiya ba - abin da ya fi muhimmanci shine su karɓi maganin a mafi girma, domin jikinsu zai iya adana shi a mafi girma.
Sakamakon ya goyi bayan binciken da aka yi a Uganda da Indonesia.
Alal misali, ƙananan gwaje-gwaje guda biyu a Indonesia sun nuna cewa za a iya ceto rayukan marasa lafiya da yawa idan aka ba su maganin rifampicin mai yawa ko ta baki ko ta hanyar allura.
Amma abin takaici, masu bincike sun yi gargadin cewa mahalarta da suka shiga wannan bincike sun yi kasa a gida fiye da yadda suka yi fatan a farko, wanda hakan na iya gurgunta sakamakonsu.
An gudanar da binciken a Afirka ta Kudu.
Yana goyan bayan shirin gudanar da gwaje-gwaje don gwada ko ya dace a ba marasa lafiyar HIV masu cutar tarin fuka a kwakwalwa allurai masu yawa na rifampicin.
Ana fatan irin wannan magani zai ceci rayukan mutane da yawa a Afirka da sauran yankuna na duniya inda tarin fuka mai tsanani matsala ce babba.
Shin haɗa takin ƙasa da biochar zai iya inganta ingancin ƙasar da ta lalace sosai a bakin teku?
Rashin ƙarfin ƙasa babban cikas ne ga noman amfanin gona a yankin Afirka da ke kudu da Sahara.
Da dama daga cikin marubuta sun ruwaito tasirin amfanin biochar da takin zamani akan ƙaruwar ƙasar.

A wannan bincike, an gudanar da gwajin kwanciyar kayan aiki na kwana 30, inda aka yi amfani da samfurin gram 120 kowanne na ƙasa mai suna Haplic acrisol wanda aka ƙara masa biochar na danyen masara (cbio), biochar na ɓawon shinkafa (rbio), biochar na ɓawon kwayar kwakwa (coco300 da coco700) ko takin gonaki na kaji (compost); da kuma biochar na ɓawon shinkafa da aka haɗa (rcocomp) ko biochar na danyen masara da aka haɗa (cococomp) a ƙimar 1% w/w na ƙari: ƙasa, bi da bi.

Sauran magunguna a cikin binciken sun haɗa da takin gonaki na hadadden kaji da kuma biochar na dankalin dawa ko biochar na huskar shinkafa (1% takin hadadden kaji + 1% biochar: 1% ƙasa w/w), bi da bi, don bincika tasirinsu akan numfashin ƙasa, pH na ƙasa; carbon na ƙwayoyin cuta na ƙasa; ikon musayar kation; jimillar carbon na ƙasa, jimillar nitrogen da kuma yawan nitrogen da ake samu.

Biochar da takin da aka yi amfani da su kaɗai ko tare, da kuma biochar da aka hada da takin sun ƙara yawan pH na ƙasa daga raka'a 0.28–2.29 na pH idan aka kwatanta da na sarrafawa ba tare da gyara ba.

Numfashin tushe daga takin gida ko takin shinkafa da aka yi, ko kuma kwal da aka yi daga dattin masara ko kuma haɗaɗɗen kwal da takin gida sun fi na sarrafawa ba tare da ƙari ba, wanda ya yi kama da na maganin kwal kawai.
Matsakaicin abubuwan gina jiki a cikin takin gida kawai da kuma cakuda tarkacen masara da takin gida sun kai kashi 37% da 117% bi da bi, fiye da na iko.

Haɗa amfani da biochar na ɓawon shinkafa da takin ƙasa ya ƙara yawan ƙwayoyin cuta masu amfani da kashi 132%, yayin da ƙara takin ƙasa kaɗai ya ƙara yawan ƙwayoyin cuta masu amfani da kashi 247%, idan aka kwatanta da na iko.

A ƙarshe, binciken ya nuna cewa amfani da takin ƙasa ko haɗa takin ƙasa da biochar, ko kuma biochar da aka yi takin ƙasa ya inganta halayen ƙasa kamar pH na ƙasa da MBC, kuma ya ƙarfafa ƙarfafa C na ƙasa ta hanyar haɓaka TOC da rage asarar C na ƙasa ta hanyar numfashi na tushe.
Biochar da takin zamani suna inganta ingancin ƙasa ga amfanin gona.

Wannan binciken ya bincika yadda biochar, abu mai dorewa da wadataccen carbon, wanda aka yi daga sharar shuke-shuke, za a iya amfani da shi wajen inganta ingancin ƙasa a yankin Afirka da ke kudu da Sahara.
Nazarin ya gano cewa biochar yana inganta ingancin ƙasa a hanya ɗaya da hanyoyin madadin da suka fi tsada kuma ba su da sauƙin samu.
Daya daga cikin manyan matsaloli da ke addabar samar da amfanin gona a yankin Afirka da ke kudu da Sahara ita ce raguwar ƙarfin ƙasa.
Ingancin ƙasa mai kyau zai haifar da ingantattun amfanin gona, wanda zai rage talauci a karkara kuma ya dawo da lalacewar albarkatun kasa.
Bincike ya nuna cewa biochar, abu ne mai dorewa, mai arzikin carbon, wanda za a iya amfani da shi wajen inganta ƙasar noma.
Biochar kayan sharar ne da ake samu daga zafiyar sinadaran halitta, ko kuma biomass, a inda iskar oxygen ta yi kadan ko kuma babu.
An nuna cewa biochar yana ƙara yawan saman ƙasa, yana ƙara samun ruwa da iska, kuma yana kunna ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin ƙasa.

Wannan binciken ya gwada tasirin biochar da takin ƙasa a kan ingancin ƙasa ta amfani da alamomi kamar numfashin ƙasa, pH na ƙasa, kasancewar ƙwayoyin cuta, yawan carbon, da kuma yawan nitrogen da ke akwai.

Masu binciken sun samar da biochar na kwalkwalwa, kwayar kwakwa da kuma huskar shinkafa ta amfani da pyrolysis, wanda ya ƙunshi zafiyar abubuwan halitta ba tare da iskar oxygen ba, a 450 °C a cikin tanda da aka samar a gida.
Masu binciken sun samar da biochar na kwasfa kwakwa ta amfani da pyrolysis a 300 °C da kuma a 700 °C.
Sannan masu binciken suka kwantar da samfuran ƙasa da aka gauraya da biochar na tsawon kwanaki 30.

Kowace samfurin ta ƙunshi ƙasa ta musamman da aka shirya wacce ake kira Haplic acrisol, wacce aka gauraya da haɗin gwiwar biochar daban-daban da aka yi daga ƙwanƙwason masara, ɓawon shinkafa ko ɓawon kwayar kwakwa, da takin gonaki na kaji.
Sauran samfurori sun ƙunshi cakuda ƙasa da takin gonar kaji, tare da biochar na ɓawon shinkafa, da biochar na ɗanɗanon masara, bi da bi.
Kowanne samfurin ya ƙunshi kashi 1% na takin ƙasa, kashi 1% ga kowanne biochar, don masu binciken su iya bincika tasirin kowanne cakuda akan ingancin ƙasa.
Masu binciken sun gano cewa ƙara biochar da takin ƙasa a cikin ƙasa, ko dai daban-daban ko tare, ya ƙara darajar pH na ƙasa daga raka'a 0.28-2.29 na pH, idan aka kwatanta da ƙasa da ba a gauraya ba.
Karuwar pH yana nufin ƙasa ta yi ƙarancin tsami.

Nazarin ya gano cewa numfashi na tushe, ko mafi karancin adadin carbon dioxide da ƙasa ke fitarwa, ya karu lokacin da aka ƙara takin ƙasa kadai, ko kuma lokacin da aka gauraya takin ƙasa da ɓawon shinkafa, ko kuma biochar na ɗanɗanon masara ko kuma biochar ɗin da aka haɗa.

Samfurin ƙasa ya nuna ƙaruwar jimillar abubuwan ƙwayoyin halittu na kashi 37% lokacin da aka yi amfani da takin ƙasa kadai, kuma ƙaruwa ta kashi 117% lokacin da aka gauraya tarkacen masara tare da takin ƙasa.

Yawan aikin ƙwayoyin cuta ya karu da kashi 132% inda ƙasa ta haɗa da cakuda takin ƙasa da tarkacen shinkafa, idan aka kwatanta da ƙaruwar kashi 247% a cikin samfuran ƙasa waɗanda ke da takin ƙasa kawai.
Sakamakon wannan bincike ya nuna cewa za a iya rage ƙarancin ƙasa ta amfani da biochar, wanda yake samuwa cikin sauƙi kuma da arha.
Wannan ya bambanta da hanyar da ta dace ta ƙara liming a ƙasa, wacce ke da tsada kuma ba ta da yawa ga manoma kanana a yankin Afirka ta Kudu da Sahara.
Hanyoyin Kwayoyin Fibrin da Ba na Al'ada a Cutar Rheumatoid Arthritis da Alaƙarsu da Cutar Autoimmunity, Kumburi da Thrombosis
Hakar cututtukan zuciya da jijiyoyin jini a marasa lafiyar RA yana da yawa sosai sakamakon kumburi a jiki.
Tasiri na dangantattu na citrullination da ke haɗuwa da cututtukan autoimmune akan tsarin da kuma yiwuwar thrombosis na fibrin(ogen) har yanzu ba a sani ba.
Don haka, mun kwatanta hanyoyin aikin jijiyoyin jini, kumburi, haɗuwa da tsarin fibrin clot a cikin marasa lafiyar RA tare da masu kula da lafiya kuma mun tantance dangantakar tsakanin ƙimar.
An tattara samfurin jini daga marasa lafiyar RA 30 da kuma masu lafiya 25 da shekaru da jinsi iri ɗaya.
An auna matakan SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 da VCAM-1 ta amfani da hanyar gwaji ta sandwich immunoassay.
An tantance haɗuwar jinin jiki gaba ɗaya ta amfani da Thromboelastography.
An bincika hanyoyin haɗin fibrin da tsarin fiber ta amfani da na’urar duban ƙwayoyin halitta ta lantarki (Scanning Electron Microscopy).
An yi gano da ƙididdige citrullination a cikin clots na fibrin da aka samar ta amfani da antibody na Citrulline mai alama mai haske tare da Confocal Microscopy.
Matakan SAA, CRP da ICAM-1 sun yi yawa sosai a marasa cutar RA idan aka kwatanta da masu iko.
Ana rage ƙimar TEG da suka shafi fara haɗuwa (R da K), saurin haɗa fibrin (α-Angle), da lokacin da aka kai mafi girman samar da thrombosis (TMRTG) a marasa lafiyar RA.
Bayanan da suka shafi ƙarfin jini (MA, MRTG, TGG) ba su bambanta da ƙididdiga ba tsakanin RA da masu iko.
Samfurin ƙididdigar hanyoyin lissafi ya nuna alaƙa mai ƙarfi tsakanin abubuwan da ke haifar da matsalar (CRP, SAA) da ma'aunin TEG fiye da alamun aikin ƙwayoyin jini.

Binciken ƙwayoyin cuta ya bayyana cewa hanyoyin haɗin fibrin masu kauri sun fi yawa a jikin marasa cutar RA idan aka kwatanta da masu iko [ matsakaici (kewayon tsakanin kashi 25%) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm bi da bi, p<0.0001,  ƙimar yuwuwar=22.7).
An gano yankuna da dama da aka citrullinate a cikin tsarin kumburin fibrin a jikin marasa cutar RA, wanda ya yi kasa a cikin samfuran iko (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Marasa lafiya masu fama da cutar RA mai aiki suna nuna halayyar haɗin jini wanda ya bambanta da abubuwan da aka gano na gama gari da ke hade da wasu cututtukan kumburi.

Sauya tsarin furotin ta hanyar citrullination da ke da alaƙa da cututtukan autoimmune na iya taka rawa wajen tantance tsarin fibrin da yuwuwar haifar da haɗarin thrombotic mai girma ga marasa lafiyar RA.
Tsaftar jini a marasa cutar sankarau na iya bayyana haɗarin kamuwa da bugun zuciya da na kwakwalwa.
Sabbin bincike kan cutar sanyin jiki ya samar da fahimtar da ta fi kyau game da yiwuwar alaƙa tsakanin wannan cuta da ƙaruwar haɗarin cututtukan zuciya.
Kumburi mai tsanani (RA) cuta ce mai ciwo da rauni, wacce ke da alaƙa da kumburi a cikin haɗin gwiwa da kuma a duk jiki.
Tun da daɗewa, masana kimiyya sun san cewa marasa lafiyar cutar kuma suna da kashi 50% ƙarin haɗarin kamuwa da cututtukan zuciya (CVD) – kamar bugun jini ko bugun zuciya.
Muhimmiyar silar wannan haɗari ita ce tasirin kumburi akan tsarin haɗa jini.
A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun bincika wannan dangantaka, domin su gano ainihin dalilin da ya sa RA ke ƙara haɗarin cututtukan zuciya da jijiyoyin jini.
Musamman ma, masu binciken sun bincika tasirin kumburi da sauye-sauyen tsarin a kan takamaiman furotin da ke da alaƙa da haɗa jini, wanda ake kira fibrin.

Wadannan sinadaran sun kasance kamar dogayen sarkar da ke samar da asalin “ƙulla” ga jinin da ya kafe, don haka duk wata canji ga fibrin kansu na iya haifar da tasirin juna ga tsarin kafewa gaba ɗaya.
Masu bincike sun kwatanta samfuran jinin marasa cutar RA da samfuran jinin mutanen da ke da lafiya.
A kowace hanya, masu binciken suna neman “alamomi” a cikin jini waɗanda ke nuna kumburi, da kuma duk wata bambanci mara kyau a cikin tsarin haɗin jini na al'ada wanda zai iya ƙara haɗarin CVD.
An kuma bincika jinin da kanshi ta hanyar microscope, domin gano duk wata sauyi a tsarin furotin na fibrin dinsu.
Masu binciken sun lura cewa jinin da ya kaure daga marasa lafiyar RA ya yi sauri fiye da na mutanen da ke da lafiya, kuma sandunan furotin da aka yi su da shi ma sun yi kauri sosai fiye da na al'ada.
Akwai kuma sauye-sauye a cikin amino acid ɗin da ke samar da furotin na fibrin, wanda ya sa suka kunna amsa ta rigakafi ta jiki, wanda hakan ya haifar da ƙarin kumburi.

Masu bincike da dama sun lura da sauye-sauye a tsarin sinadarin amino acid na fibrins a haɗin gwiwar marasa cutar RA a da, amma wannan shi ne karo na farko da masu bincike suka ga wannan tasirin a jini.

Idan aka haɗa da sauran canje-canjen da aka gani a cikin jinin da ya kaure, binciken na iya taimaka wa masana kimiyya su fahimci dangantakar da ke tsakanin RA da CVD sosai, da kuma yadda za a gano alamun farko na waɗannan cututtukan.
Ko da yake sakamakon farko-farko masu alkawarin ne, ya kamata a lura cewa girman samfurin binciken ya yi ƙanƙanta.

Masu binciken sun kuma ambata cewa hanyar da suka yi amfani da ita wajen gano canjin amino acid a cikin furotin na iya ɗaukar sakamako daga abubuwa marasa alaƙa, ma'ana za a buƙaci gwaje-gwaje na musamman da ke nufin fibrins don tabbatar da sakamakon a nan gaba.
A ƙarshe, fahimtar alaƙar rikitarwa tsakanin RA da ƙaruwar haɗarin CVD na iya inganta sakamakon ga marasa lafiyar RA yayin da muke koyo don gano da kuma magance waɗannan cututtukan yadda ya kamata.
Masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu, Denmark da Birtaniya sun shiga wannan bincike, wanda Hukumar Binciken Lafiya ta Afirka ta Kudu ta ba da kuɗi.
Hasashen yanayin teku ga masu amfani da tekun gabar teku – ra'ayoyi, amfani da karɓuwa.
Wannan binciken na yanzu yana mai da niyya magance rashin jituwa tsakanin kimiyya da jama'a a matsayin rashin daidaito a samarwa da buƙatar bayanai wanda aka sani da gibin amfani.
A wannan yanayin, mun bincika muhimmancin bayanan yanayin teku (metocean) kamar yadda masu amfani a ƙasashe biyu na ƙasar kudancin duniya suka gani:
Afirka ta Kudu da kuma New Zealand.
A nan, ba wai kawai ana mai da hankali kan yadda ake ganin, amfani da kuma karɓar hasashen bala'o'i masu tsanani ba, amma ma'ana a kan yadda ake amfani da hasashen yau da kullun.
An gudanar da binciken ta hanyar bincike, wanda aka tsara shi bisa tambayoyin bincike guda uku.

Tambayoyin binciken sun rufe batutuwa daga ƙira da dacewar kayan aikin hasashen, daidaito da dorewa, amfani, kima da martaba ta cibiyoyi, da kuma rashin tabbas dangane da sauyin yanayi (don ambaton kaɗan).
An raba tambayoyin bincike na kan layi sosai don haɗa masu amfani da nishaɗi da na kasuwanci.
Nazarin ya mayar da hankali kan gano al'adun yanke shawara masu yuwuwa waɗanda ke shafar bukatun bayanan masu amfani da tekun gabar teku.

An yi amfani da binciken yarjejeniyar al’adu (CCA) don bincika fahimtar da aka raba da bambance-bambancen ra’ayoyi a cikin rukunin masu amsa tambayoyi baki ɗaya, da kuma a cikin ƙungiyoyin ƙananan ƙungiyoyi da kuma ƙasashe.
Mun sami matakai daban-daban na amincewa a cikin ƙungiyar baki ɗaya (masu shiga daga ƙasashe biyu da dukkan sassan da aka haɗa) idan aka kwatanta da ƙungiyoyin masu amfani daban-daban.

Duk mahalarta da aka ɗauka tare sun nuna matsakaicin amincewar al'adu game da batutuwan da aka gabatar, amma tare da wasu bambance-bambance a ra'ayoyin a matakin ƙasa, wanda ke nuna yuwuwar al'adun ƙarƙashin ƙasa.

Idan aka yi nazari daban-daban kan ƙungiyoyin ƙasa da na fannoni, mun ga cewa akwai matsaya ta al'adu mafi inganci a cikin ƙungiyar masu amfani ta Afirka ta Kudu, tare da amincewa mai ƙarfi ba tare da la'akari da alaƙar fannoni ba.
Rukunin masu amfani da kasuwanci na New Zealand sun nuna rashin yarda mafi ƙaranci da sauran ƙungiyoyin.
Mun tattauna tasirin abubuwan da muka samu akan muhimman abubuwa a karɓar sabis kuma saboda haka akan samar da hasashen da suka dace.
An kuma tattauna fifiko da dama na hasashen kimiyya a nan gaba, la'akari da tasirin sauyin yanayi da ake sa ran.
Mun ƙarasa ne ta hanyar gabatar da tsarin tunani don haskaka muhimmiyar hulɗa tsakanin haɓaka samfurin hasashen da daidaito/daidaito na kimiyya.
'Yan Afirka ta Kudu da kuma 'Yan New Zealand suna amincewa da hasashen yanayin teku.
'Yan Afirka ta Kudu da kuma 'Yan New Zealand da ke aiki da zama a yankunan bakin teku suna dogaro da ayyukan hasashen yanayi masu sauƙin amfani, waɗanda ke ba da hasashen daidai akai-akai.
Ayyukan hasashen yanayi na ƙasa da kuma shafukan yanar gizo daban-daban na kasuwanci suna bayar da hasashen yadda yanayin zai kasance.
Suna ƙoƙarin zama daidai kuma masu amfani gwargwado.
Ilimin kimiyya da tunanin kimiyya sosai ne ke shiga irin wannan hasashen.

A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun zaɓi su kalli yadda mutane a Afirka ta Kudu da New Zealand ke amfani da ayyukan hasashen yanayi – ƙasashe biyu suna da tsaunin rairayin bakin teku masu tsayi, amma suna da yawan jama'a da yanayin bakin teku daban-daban sosai.
Sun so su gano sau nawa ‘yan ƙasar bakin teku ke amfani da ayyukan hasashen yanayi na ƙasa ko na kasuwanci, domin waɗanne dalilai da ko sun same su da amfani kuma masu aminci.
Wadannan su ne muhimman abubuwa dangane da yadda sauyin yanayi na gaba zai iya shafar hasashen yanayi.
An amsa tambayoyin bincike na kan layi daga mutane 31 'yan Afirka ta Kudu da kuma mutane 126 'yan New Zealand.

Sun haɗa da mutanen da ke amfani da hasashen yanayi don ayyukan aiki (alāl misali masu kamun kifi da kungiyoyin neman ceto), da kuma wasu da ke shiga cikin wasanni da ayyukan nishaɗi masu alaƙa da teku kamar hawa igiyar ruwa, iyo, ko kuma iyo.
Masu bincike sun yi tambayoyi game da sauƙin amfani da sabis ɗin hasashen yanayi da aka fi so, da kuma daidaito da ƙarfin hasashen sa.
Masu halarta sun lissafa abubuwan da suka sa ya zama da amfani kuma ya fi muhimmanci a gare su, sannan suka ce ko hakan na iya canzawa saboda sauyin yanayi.
Sun kuma buƙaci su ce ko sun amince da bayanin da hukumomin yanayi na ƙasarsu suka bayar, da kuma yadda suka ji game da hakan.
Yawancin ‘yan Afirka ta Kudu da suka shiga binciken masu shakatawa ne a teku, ko kuma mutanen da ke taimakawa wajen aikin ceto da neman batattu ko kuma ayyukan bincike.
Yawancin 'yan New Zealand da suka amsa tambayoyin sun kalli hasashen yanayi domin suna son zuwa kamun kifi, ko kuma hawa jirgin ruwa, ko kuma iyo a teku.
Masu halarta daga ƙasashen biyu sun amince da bayanin da hukumomin kula da yanayi na ƙasashensu suka ba su.
Sun fi son ayyukan hasashen da ke daidaito, daidaituwa, sauƙin amfani, kuma suna da fasalulluka da za a iya daidaita su da bukatunsu.
Masu shiga da suka yi amfani da wannan sabis ɗin don manufar aiki a zahiri sun ga cewa hasashen yanayin tekun da ke kusa da rairayin bakin teku ba su daidaita ba.
Bayanan wasu yankuna sun fi na wasu daidaito.
‘Yan Afirka ta Kudu sun fi ‘yan New Zealand amfani da ayyukan hasashen yanayi, kuma suna dubawa aƙalla sau ɗaya a rana.
Ga kashi 9 daga cikin kowane masu amsa tambayoyi 10, tsarin hasashen da ya yi matuƙa kyau abu ne mai matuƙar muhimmanci.
Yawancin sun fi son sabis da ke ba da kallo na kwanaki uku zuwa bakwai a nan gaba.
Mutane da ke aiki a noma a ruwa ko kuma waɗanda suka yi shirin gaggawa suna buƙatar hasashen dogon lokaci da na kakar.
Yawancin masu amfani sun yi imanin cewa saboda ƙaruwar canjin yanayi, ayyukan hasashen za su yi amfani da ingantattun bayanai masu tushe a kimiyya a nan gaba don tabbatar da hasashen daidai.
Kaɗan daga cikin irin waɗannan nazarin an yi su a baya a ƙasashen ƙasa ta Kudu.
Masu binciken suna fatan sun samu isasshen ilimi daga mahalarta bisa ga tambayoyin da suka yi musu.
Wani rauni kuma shi ne cewa mutane da yawa daga New Zealand sun shiga binciken fiye da waɗanda suka fito daga Afirka ta Kudu.
Aikin nasu zai taimaka wa mutanen da ke aiki a wuraren hasashen yanayi wajen tsara samfurori masu kyau waɗanda ke ɗauke da buƙatun abokan cinikinsu a zuciya.
Za su iya yin gyare-gyare da sauye-sauye dangane da yadda abokan cinikinsu ke gamsuwa da dalilin amfani da shi.
Hanyar Haɗin Kai wajen Kimanta Yadda Tsarin Noma ke Dacewa da Yanayin Sauyin Yanayi:
Al'amari na Lushoto
Tsarin noma mai dacewa da yanayin sauyin yanayi (CSA) na samun karbuwa a duk duniya.
Amma, ba ta bayyana abin da ya kamata a rufe a ƙarƙashin ginshiƙai uku—ƙarfin aiki, juriya da rage tasirin haɗari ba.
Saboda haka, CSA ya ƙunshi ayyuka/fasahohin noma da dama, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama da wuya a fifita manufofin CSA.
Da farko, akwai rashin ka’idoji masu bayyane da kuma hanyoyin aiki don tantance ingancin hanyoyin magance matsalar yanayi.
Na biyu, bayanai kaɗan ne ke akwai game da tasirin hanyoyin magance matsalar da aka riga aka yi tallata su a matsayin CSA, musamman a ƙasashen da ke tasowa.
A ƙarshe, fifikon CSA bai ɗauki ra’ayoyin masu ruwa da tsaki ba don tabbatar da cewa hanyoyin magance matsalar sun dace, sun yi daidai kuma suna da damar amfani sosai.
A nan, mun bayyana sabon tsarin haɗin gwiwa na tantance ingancin noma mai dacewa da yanayin sauyin yanayi a cikin ayyukan manoma kanana.
Wannan ya tantance alamomin matakin gonaki (da kuma hanyoyin tantancewa) na ginshiƙan tsaron abinci da daidaitawa na CSA.
Hakanan yana tallafawa ƙididdigar haɗin gwiwa ta nuni, yana ba da damar yin kimantawa na farko da na gaba na wayewar yanayi.
An gwada tsarin a tsakanin manoma 72 da ke aiwatar da hanyoyin magance matsalar sauyin yanayi daban-daban a kauyen Lushoto na Tanzania, wanda ke da wayewa game da yanayin yanayi.

Musamman manoma sun yaba da ayyukan da suka inganta ƙarfin ƙasa da tsarinta, rage kwararar ruwa a saman ƙasa, da kuma dawo da ƙasar da ta lalace saboda tasirin da suka yi a kan amfanin ƙasa da kuma noma a lokacin da ba lokacin noma ba ne.
Yawancin lokaci, ayyukan CSA sun ƙara samar da dabbobi, samar da abinci, cin abinci da kuma kudin shiga.
Hanyar aiki tana da sauƙin daidaitawa zuwa yankuna daban-daban da kuma tsarin noma kuma tana ba da damar fifita shirye-shiryen gyara sosai.
Amma muna ba da shawara cewa a ɗauki CSA a matsayin ɓangare na tsarin sa ido, tantancewa da koyo.
Sabbin hanyoyin sa ido na taimaka wa masana kimiyya da manoma shiri don sauyin yanayi.
Masana kimiyya da ke aiki tare da manoma a Tanzaniya yanzu za su iya auna yadda sabbin hanyoyin noma ke taimakawa wajen rage illar sauyin yanayi.
Suna fatan hanyarsu za ta inganta tsaron abinci da kuma yawan amfanin gona ga manoma a wasu sassan duniya ma.
"Aikin noma mai dacewa da yanayin sauyin yanayi" abu ne Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ke ƙarfafawa domin taimaka wa manoma kanana su shirya don sauyin yanayi.
Manomi mai wayo game da yanayi yana daidaita da sauye-sauyen yanayi kuma yana iya ƙara tsaron abinci ta hanyar ƙara yawan amfanin gonarsa.
Wannan matsala ce mai matukar muhimmanci ga manoma Tanzaniya, domin ƙasar na fama da raguwar amfanin gona na amfanin hatsi masu muhimmanci sakamakon sauyin yanayi.

Amma, masu bincike sun ce yana da wuya a auna nasarar hanyoyin magance matsalar yanayi, kamar sinadarai, kuma manoma kansu ba a koyaushe ake tuntubar su ba game da ko hanyoyin sun yi aiki kamar yadda aka nufa.
A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su tsara hanya don auna nasarar hanyoyin magance sauyin yanayi, tare da mayar da hankali musamman kan inganta tsaron abinci da daidaitawa.
Da farko, sun karanta wasu nazarin noma sannan suka samar da jerin abubuwa guda 2 wadanda suka hada da abubuwa 14, ko “alamomi”, wadanda suka da muhimmanci wajen auna tsaron abinci da daidaitawa.

Sannan, suna aiki a gundumar Lushoto ta Tanzania, masu binciken sun hada kai da manoma na yankin da kuma kwararru a fannin noma da dama domin gano muhimman abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci daga kowace jerin.
Manoman sun gano samar da abinci a matsayin alama mai matukar muhimmanci wajen tabbatar da tsaron abinci.
Wato, duk wani shiri da ya inganta amfanin gonakinsu yana da matukar muhimmanci.

A halin yanzu, game da bangaren daidaitawa, manoma musamman sun nuna sha'awa ga hanyoyin da suka taimaka musu wajen kare ƙasar gonakinsu, da kuma waɗanda suka inganta ilimi, ƙwarewa, da kudin shigansu.
Da zarar masu binciken sun tantance muhimmancin kowane alama, sun iya amfani da su wajen gwada ko hanyoyin magance matsalar shida a Lushoto sun yi nasara.
A kowace hanya, sun tambayi manoma na yankin, akan sikelin 1-5, ko akwai karuwa a kowanne alama tun lokacin da aka fara shirin.
Wannan ya ba su damar ganin wacce daga cikin hanyoyin magance matsalar ta fi tasiri wajen tabbatar da tsaron abinci da kuma daidaitawa.
Sun gano kawai 3 daga cikin hanyoyin magance matsalar 6 da ake amfani da su ne ke da tasiri na gaske.
Wadannan su ne iri-irin amfanin gona masu jure fari, kuma suna samar da abinci mai kyau ga dabbobi.
Masu binciken sun ce hanyarsu ta sauƙaƙa tabbatar da cewa shirye-shiryen da za a yi nan gaba za su cika bukatun manoma a Lushoto da kuma manufofin noma mai dacewa da yanayin sauyin yanayi.

Sun ƙara da cewa zaɓin hanyoyin magance matsalar da suka dace yana kuma ƙara yuwuwar manoma za su ba makwabtansu shawara kan ayyuka nagari, ta haka ne za a yada ra’ayoyin noma mai dacewa da yanayin sauyin yanayi.

A ma’anar faɗi, za a iya amfani da wannan hanya a wasu yankuna, kuma za ta taimaka wajen tabbatar da cewa dabarun da suka dace da yanayin yanayi sun ɗauki yanayin yankin da ilimin manoma a la’akari ta hanyar ci gaba da bin diddigi da tantancewa.
Ta haka ne, ƙoƙarin noma mai dacewa da yanayin zafi za su iya samun nasara sosai kuma su yadu, a Tanzaniya da kuma sauran ƙasashen Afirka.
Nazarin hadin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya daga Kenya da Netherlands.
Kwayoyin cuta na Dabbobi masu kashin baya a matsayin nau'ikan da suka mamaye:  Fahimta daga Afirka ta Kudu
Nazarin ƙwayoyin cuta masu cutarwa a matsayin nau'ikan tsire-tsire baƙi bai samu kulawa sosai ba a fannin kimiyyar mamaya.
Cututtukan da aka gabatar na iya yin tasiri mai zurfi ga halittu masu rai, tsarin halittu da suke zaune, da kuma tattalin arzikin da tsarin halittu ke tallafawa.

A wannan babi, mun yi amfani da nazarin lokuta na cututtukan da aka gabatar na dabbobi gida da na daji (kamar cutar kyama a karnuka, tarin fuka a shanu, da kuma cutar rinderpest) da kuma na mutane (kamar cutar kanjamau, sankarau da kuma cutar HIV) don nuna irin tasirin da wadannan kwayoyin cuta zasu iya haifarwa.
Tasiri mafi muni har zuwa yau shine na cutar rinderpest, wacce ta haifar da mutuwar miliyoyin shanu, kuma ta kusan share wasu nau'ikan namun daji daga sassan kudancin Afirka.
Wannan kuwa ya shafi tattalin arzikin yankin sosai, kuma ya haifar da manyan sauye-sauye a tsarin da kuma motsin halittu.

An kawar da cutar shanun rinderpest a duniya baki daya, amma cutar kyama da ke addabar karnuka da kuma ta shanun turɓaya har yanzu suna nan, kuma za a buƙaci ci gaba da taka tsantsan da kuma kulawa don shawo kansu.
Daga cikin cututtukan ɗan adam, an kuma kawar da cutar sankarau a duniya baki ɗaya, amma tasirin cutar, wadda masu mulkin mallaka na Turai suka gabatar, ya yi barna sosai.

A farkon shekarun 1700, yawancin mutanen Khoekhoe na asali (har zuwa kashi 90% a wasu al'ummomi) sun mutu, wanda ya lalata al'adunsu da hanyar rayuwarsu, kuma ya bar 'yan tsirarun da suka rage a matsayin ma'aikatan noma.
HIV, wanda aka gano shi a Afirka ta Kudu a shekarar 1982, ya kuma yi tasiri sosai, kuma maganin rigakafin cutar kanta kaɗai yana kashe gwamnati Naira biliyan 66.4 a kowace shekara.
Mun kuma haɗa cutar West Nile da cutar shanƙar Afirka a matsayin misalan cututtuka da suka samo asali daga Afirka, kuma har yanzu za su iya zama masu lalata a duniya baki ɗaya.
Muna hasashen cewa sabbin cututtuka za su bullo yayin da mutane suka ci gaba da fadada yankunansu zuwa wuraren daji, da kuma yayin da yawan cinikayya ya karu.
Abin da masana kimiyya suka sani game da ƙwayoyin cuta masu ƙanƙanta da ke haifar da cututtuka a Afirka ta Kudu

Wannan babi na littafi ya taƙaita bayanai na baya-bayan nan game da cututtuka kamar rinderpest, kyama, sankarau da HIV, wadanda dukkan su cututtukan kamuwa da cuta ne (kwayoyin cuta, ƙwayoyin cuta da sauran ƙananan halittu da ake ɗauka ba na asali ba ne, ma'ana ba a samu su a wani yanayi ba).
Wadannan cututtuka dukkansu suna shafar dabbobi da mutane a Afirka ta Kudu, kuma barkewar cututtukan a ƙarshe suna cutar da tattalin arzikin ƙasar.

A cikin filin bincike da ake kira ‘invasive science’, masana kimiyya suna nazari kan halittu masu rai waɗanda ke bunƙasa da kuma haifar da illa bayan da aka gabatar da su a cikin sabbin yanayi inda ba a saba samun su ba.
Yawancin bincike sun mayar da hankali kan manyan “jikin da ke mamaye” kamar tsire-tsire da dabbobi, amma ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta masu haifar da cututtuka suma suna da muhimmanci.
A wannan babi, marubuta sun tattauna wasu cututtukan dabbobi da na ɗan adam a Afirka ta Kudu waɗanda ƙwayoyin cuta da aka shigo da su ke haifarwa.
Sun ce cutar da ta fi hatsari ita ce cutar ‘rinderpest’, wadda aka gano a Afirka ta Kudu a shekara ta 1896.
Cututtukan shanun rinderpest cututtuka ce da ke shafar shanu da dabbobin daji, kuma ta samo asali ne daga kwayar cutar.
Wannan kwayar cutar ɗaya ce ta haifar da sankarau a mutane.
Mutane da yawa a karkara sun fuskanci yunwa bayan barkewar cutar ta shekarar 1896, amma yanzu an kawar da cutar ta hanyar allurar riga-kafi.
Marubuta sun ce tsakanin shekarar 1772 zuwa 1861, karnuka da yawa a Afirka ta Kudu suna dauke da cutar kyama, duk da cewa mutane ba su san irin wannan cuta ba.

Zuwa shekara ta 1893, an riga an san cewa cutar kyama ce ta haifar da cutar kyama, don haka gwamnati ta yanke shawarar kashe karnukan da suka kamu da cutar da kuma yi wa wadanda ba su kamu ba allurar riga-kafi.
Amma, wannan bai kawar da cutar ba kuma har yanzu tana shafar da yawan dabbobi da dama kamar su: duikers, zakuna, karnukan daji, jakaloli da kuma raguna.
Marubuta sun ce a shekara ta 1928, yara biyu sun mutu sakamakon kamuwa da cutar kyama bayan da wata macijiyar rawaya ta ciji su.
Tun daga lokacin, cutar kyama ta zama ruwan dare a Afirka ta Kudu.
Sun ce a shekara ta 1954,  Afirka ta Kudu da yawa kuma cutar sankarau ta shafa.
Lokacin da aka rubuta wannan babi, sankarar mura na kashe yara kusan 400 a kowace rana.
Sun ce sankarau na yaduwa sosai a wuraren da mutane da shanu ke zaune tare.
Marubuta sun kuma ambaci wata cuta mai suna shanƙarar shanu (BTB), wadda ƙwayoyin cuta ke haifarwa.
BTB ya kashe shanu, jaki, dabbobin daji, damisa, damisa, kudus, bera da kuma zakuna.
Sun ce an fara samun rahoton cutar BTB a wani wurin shakatawa na ƙasa a Afirka ta Kudu a shekarar 1996.
Gwamnati ta shawo kan cutar ta hanyar kashe dabbobin Buffalo da suka kamu da cutar.
Marubuta sun ce wata cuta, wadda masu tafiya daga Turai suka shigo da ita Afirka ta Kudu, ta haifar da wata cuta mai suna ‘farantawa’ a jikin mutane.
Cututtukan ya kashe sama da kashi 90% na mutanen Khoekhoe na yankin.
A ƙarshen barkewar cutar, al'adun Khoekhoe ta kusan lalacewa.
Marubuta sun kuma bayar da rahoto kan cutar kamuwa da cutar immunodeficiency ta ɗan adam (HIV) wadda ta haifar da barkewar cutar AIDS.
Masana kimiyya har yanzu suna ganin cewa an fara yada cutar zuwa ga mutane daga dabbobi, a wani tsari da ake kira zoonosis.
An fara gano kwayar cutar a Afirka ta Kudu a shekarar 1982.
Sun ce, tun daga shekara ta 2019, babu riga-kafin cutar HIV ko maganinta.
Sun ƙarasa babi ta hanyar tattaunawa game da cutar West Nile da cutar shanƙar naman alade ta Afirka, inda suka ce ta samo asali daga Afirka sannan ta yadu zuwa Turai da Amurka.
Kwayar cutar West Nile, sauro ne suka yada ta, kuma ta kashe tsuntsaye mafi yawa, amma kuma ta shafi dawakai da mutane.
Sun ce dabbobi irin su warthog da dabbobin daji masu kama da alade ne ke yada cutar mura ta naman alade ta Afirka.
Cututtukan sun shafi aladu, kuma sun shafi harkokin kasuwancin aladu matuka.
Marubuta sun ce sun tattauna kawai cututtukan da ƙwayoyin cuta da ƙwayoyin cuta ke haifarwa, don haka wannan babi ba cikakken bayanin dukkan ƙwayoyin cuta masu kutse ba ne.
Marubutan daga Afirka ta Kudu ne.
Hanya ta aiki ta tiyata bisa shaida don magance cyst na hakori.
Sarrafa cutar kankarin hakori mai suna odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) yadda ya kamata har yanzu yana da muhimmanci kuma yana haifar da rudani a rubuce-rubucen tiyata ta baki da fuska.
A halin yanzu, babu matsaya gama gari game da mafi dacewar maganin marasa lafiya da ke fama da cutar odontogenic keratocyst.
Daga cikin hanyoyin magani daban-daban da ake da su, babu wata hanya har zuwa yau da aka nuna tana da kashi ɗaya ko kusan ɗaya na sake dawowa sai kawai cirewa sosai tare da gefuna masu tsafta.

Dangane da karancin shaidu masu tushe a fannin tiyata don kula da marasa lafiya da ke fama da cutar odontogenic keratocyst a rubuce-rubucen kimiyya, wannan bincike yana da nufin gabatar da tsarin aikin tiyata, bisa ga sakamakon nazari, wanda hakan zai amfana wajen inganta maganin marasa lafiya da ke fama da wannan cuta.

Ta amfani da ƙayyadaddun abubuwa kamar; girma, nau'in rauni (na farko ko na biyu), yanayin raunin (wanda ke tare da wasu alamomi ko shi kaɗai), kasancewar ramuka a saman kwakwalwa, da kuma yawan ɓangarori; mun gabatar da itacen shawara, don taimakawa shirin magani da kuma samun ƙarancin damar sake dawowa a kula da kumburin hakori na odontogenic keratocyst.
Masu bincike sun ba da shawarwari kan hanyoyin ingantaccen maganin cututtukan haƙori.

Ta hanyar tattara sakamakon bincike da suka gabata, masu bincike sun bayyana matakai masu bayyana waɗanda likitoci za su iya bi don gano da kuma kula da marasa lafiya da ke fama da cutar haƙori mai suna ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
OKC rauni ne, ko kuma ci gaba mara daidaito, a gemu na mutum.
Likitoci sun ga yanayin yana da wuya a warkar da shi, kuma marasa lafiya sau da yawa suna kamuwa da wata OKC ko da bayan samun nasarar magani.
Don haka, likitoci na neman hanyoyin da za su warkar da waɗannan raunukan haƙori yadda ya kamata kuma har abada.
A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun nemi matakan da likitoci ya kamata su ɗauka don gano da kuma magance cutar.
Sun yi haka ne ta hanyar bincika littattafan da suka riga suka wanzu, ko kuma rubutattun bincike na kimiyya, game da OKC.
Sun yi ƙoƙari musamman ne don neman bayanai kan yadda likitoci suka kula da OKC a cikin shekara ɗaya, kamar yadda aka ruwaito a cikin labarai 46 da suka samu.
Masu binciken sun gano cewa OKC ya fi yawa a maza fiye da mata, kuma yana iya shafar mutane har zuwa shekaru 90, duk da cewa ya fi yawa tsakanin shekaru 20 zuwa 30.
Cututtukan ya fi shafar ƙasan leɓe.
OKC yana fara daga cikin kashi, tare da kumburi a  ƙashin  jaw kawai  ake gani daga baya.
Yawancin marasa lafiya suna jin ciwo kuma suna da wasu fitowar ruwa (ruwa, kamar ƙura, wanda ke fitowa daga rauni ko rauni), kuma tushen haƙoransu na iya motsawa daga wurin.
Sun ba da shawara cewa likitoci su cire dukkanin raunin da haƙoran da ke kusa.

Da zarar an cire su, ya kamata su shafa maganin da ake kira Carnoy’s solution, tare da nitrogen mai ruwa (ruwa mai sanyi sosai da ake amfani da shi wajen cire fata da ta lalace da sauri) da kuma fluorouracil (wanda kuma aka sani da 5FU, maganin cutar kansa na gama gari).
Bayan wannan magani, masu binciken sun ba da shawarar cewa mai haƙuri ya kamata ya yi binciken lafiya na tsawon shekaru 25.
Sun ce wannan maganin shine mafi kyau ga raunuka ƙanana da ƙarami fiye da 'ya'yan itacen strawberries (3 cm).
Ga raunuka masu girma sama da santimita 3, masu binciken sun ba da shawarar ƙarin kulawa.
Sun ce likitoci ya kamata a farko su rage matsin lamba a cikin raunin kuma su cire ruwa, kuma su cire dukkanin nama a kusa da haƙƙori.
Sai a yi maganin kashi da maganin Carnoy.
Sun ba da shawara cewa likitoci su duba wa wadannan marasa lafiya kowane wata biyu na tsawon shekaru biyu.
Idan mai rashin lafiya yana da raunuka da yawa, likitoci kuma za su iya fitar da su ta amfani da kayan aikin asibiti na musamman.
Amma a zahiri, nazarin da aka yi bitar sun nuna cewa a mafi yawan lokuta, idan likitoci suka cire gurɓataccen fata kuma suka shafa 5FU, marasa lafiya ba za su sake kamuwa da OKC ba.
Duk da haka, sun yi gargadi cewa shaidar waɗannan magunguna ba koyaushe take ƙarfi ba, kuma sun sami ƙarancin littattafan kimiyya a kan wannan batu.
Masu binciken kuma ba su gudanar da gwaje-gwajen su ba don tabbatar da waɗannan shawarwari; maimakon haka, sun ƙoƙarta su tattara mafi kyawun zabin magani daga nazarin da sauran masu bincike suka yi.
Don haka, waɗannan masu bincike, da ke zaune a Najeriya da Amurka, sun ba da shawarar yin ƙarin bincike a ƙasashe daban-daban don gwada nasarar magungunan da aka ba da shawara a nan.
Sun kuma ƙarfafa likitoci su yi la’akari da sauran yanayin marasa lafiya yayin magani.
Rigakafin SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV), MERS-CoV da SARSr-CoV na roba:  Nazari ta hanyar kwamfuta don gabatar da ɓangarorin da za a iya amfani da su a matsayin rigakafi.

Kwayar cutar Coronavirus na da takamaiman nau'in dabbobi a matsayin masauki, dabbobi masu nono ko tsuntsaye dangane da nau'insu; duk da haka, waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta na iya canza masauki a wani lokaci sakamakon sauyi.
HCoV-229E daya ne daga cikin ƙwayoyin cuta shida na ɗan adam da suka haɗa da HCoV-NL63, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-HKU1, MERS-CoV da SARSr-CoV (SARSr-CoV-1 da SARS-CoV2), kuma ana samunsa a duk duniya.
MERS-CoV da SARS-CoV-2 na iya ci gaba da wanzuwa a saman abubuwa marasa rai kamar (ƙarfe, gilashi ko filastik har zuwa kwana tara) (Huang, C.-L, 2020).
Matakan rigakafi da maganin rigakafi na Hydroxychloroquine suna da amfani, amma ana iya buƙatar ingantaccen allurar riga-kafi don dakatar da yaduwar annobar cutar covid-19.
Makasudin nazarinmu shine gano ɓangarorin rigakafin cuta ta hanyoyin kere-kere na kwamfuta.
Kayan aiki da Hanyar

An samu cikakkun jerin ƙwayoyin halittar SARS-CoV-2 daga tushen Kayayyakin Korona ta Shekarar 2019 (2019nCoVR) da kuma ginshiƙai biyu, ciki har da Cibiyar Ƙasa ta Bayanan Fasaha ta Halittu (NCBI)  Ƙungiyar Duniya kan Raba Duk Bayanan cutar mura (GISAID) da kuma TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver don ilimin halittu na kan layi.

Za mu yi takaice game da asalin ƙwayar cuta, mu kwatanta bayanan jeri don gano yankin da aka kiyaye, mafi yawan yankin furotin (wurin haɗi na manufa) da kuma tsarin haɗin kai don ƙirƙirar ƙwayar cuta mai yiwuwa (epitope) don magance cututtukan da aka gano kwanan nan na 2019-nCoV, SARSr-CoV da MERS-CoV.
Abin mamaki, kwatanta jerin ƙwayoyin SARS-CoV-2 da wata cuta ta nuna cewa sinadaran da ke cikin sashen hulɗa da mai karɓa sun yi kama sosai tare da kashi 70% na kama.

Mun tallafa wa muhimman sinadarai masu gina jiki guda biyar (L455, Y473, N479, F486, Q493) a yankin ɗaure mai karɓa daga sinadaran furotin masu kauri da ke da alhakin hulɗa tsakanin ƙwayar cuta da mai dauke da ita.
A cikin yankin muhimmin ɓangaren ƙwayar cuta ta SARS-CoV, akwai sinadarai (D480, da T487) waɗanda suka ba da damar kamuwa da cutar tsakanin nau'ikan dabbobin daban-daban.
Amma, a cikin SARS-CoV-2, ɗan ƙaramin gyara na wasu sinadarai na iya inganta hulɗa da mai karɓar kwayar halittar ɗan adam: L455, F486, Q493, da N501.
A cikin SARS-CoV,  sassan halittu guda biyu masu muhimmanci (479 da 487) sun shahara wajen gane mai karɓar ACE2 na ɗan adam.
A cikin SARS-CoV-2, sinadaran da suka dace da N479 sun dace da Q493 da T487 zuwa N501.

Mun gano jerin sunayen amino acid ɗin da aka kiyaye sosai a tsakanin kwayoyin cutar corona da yawa, ciki har da 2019nCoV da sauran nau'o'i, an gano tsarin KRSFIEDLLFNKVTLADAGF ya kasance mai kyau sosai a wannan binciken kuma yana dacewa da yankin da ke kewaye da ɗaya daga cikin wuraren da aka sani na yanke na kwayar cutar SARS wanda ake ganin ana buƙata don kunna kwayar cutar don shiga cikin sel.

Wannan tsarin ɓangaren ƙwayar halitta da bambancin da ke kewaye da shi sun zama tushen gabatar da takamaiman ɓangaren rigakafin halitta; wannan binciken na iya samar da abubuwan da suka dace masu ƙarfi da ƙananan ƙwayoyin halitta da kuma abubuwan da ke haɗuwa.
Wannan binciken yana bayar da bayanai da damammaki don tabbatar da halittu.

Duk da haka, za a iya bayyana aikin a fannin ilimin halittu ta hanyar kwamfuta, kuma wasu za su iya maimaita shi sauƙaƙe, duk da cewa sabbin bayanai da bincike kan cutar Covid-19 suna fitowa da kuma ci gaba da sauri.
Masana kimiyya suna kwatanta cutar Covid-19 da wasu cututtukan da suka yi kama da ita domin taimakawa wajen nemo magungunan riga-kafi.

A watan Satumba na shekarar 2020, masana kimiyya a Mali sun kwatanta bayanan halittar ƙwayar cutar Covid-19 da ƙwayoyin cuta guda biyu masu alaƙa da juna don gano halaye da za su iya taimakawa wajen samar da allurar riga-kafi.
A lokacin, masana kimiyya har yanzu suna neman alluran rigakafi masu nasara na cutar Covid-19.
Sun so su gano canje-canje a kwayar cutar Covid-19 da za su iya taka rawa a kamuwa da cutar.
Don haka, masu binciken Mali sun kwatanta kwayar cutar Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) da wasu kwayoyin cutar coronavirus guda biyu da ke haifar da cututtuka ga mutane, wato MERS-CoV da SARS-CoV.
Daya daga cikin manyan manufofin binciken shine gano wurare na musamman a kan kwayar cutar Covid-19, da ake kira epitopes, waɗanda tsarin garkuwar jikin ɗan adam zai iya gane su.
Gano su zai taimaka wa masana kimiyya wajen ƙirƙirar alluran riga-kafi masu inganci.
Masu binciken sun kuma kwatanta dukkan cututtukan ƙwayoyin cuta guda uku don ganin ko akwai kama-da-wane na kwayoyin halitta da zai iya taimakawa ƙarin ci gaban rigakafin cutar.

Sun mayar da hankali kan tsarin kwayoyin halittar furotin mai kauri na ƙwayoyin cuta, wato furotin ɗin da ke da alhakin taimaka wa ƙwayoyin cuta na corona su manne, su kuma kamu da ƙwayoyin halittar ɗan adam.
Abin da masu binciken suka gano shi ne cewa sinadaran kwayar cutar guda uku sun yi kama sosai, musamman sassan da ke hulɗa da kwayoyin halittar ɗan adam.
Abin da ya bambanta game da cutar COVID-19 shine akwai wasu ƙananan sauye-sauye a cikin furotin mai kauri wanda zai iya sa kwayar cutar ta zama mai inganci wajen haɗuwa da ƙwayoyin jikin ɗan adam.

Sakamakon wannan bincike na iya ba sauran masu bincike damar ƙirƙirar alluran riga-kafin cutar Covid-19 masu inganci ta hanyar taimaka musu wajen gano wurare a kan ƙwayar cuta waɗanda suke da kyawawan buri ga alluran riga-kafi.
Binciken ya kuma samar da sababbin bayanai game da kama-da-wane da bambance-bambancen halittar ƙwayoyin cuta na cutar Covid-19 da sauran ƙwayoyin cuta na coronavirus.

Masu binciken sun lura cewa bincike na gaba ya kamata ya mayar da hankali kan ko bambance-bambancen halittar ƙwayar cuta ta Covid-19 ya sa ta zama mai kamuwa da cuta kuma ta fi sauran ƙwayoyin cuta masu kama da kwayar cutar corona haɗari.
Matsalolin Bugawa na Zuciya a Marasa Cutar COVID-19:  Bincike na Tsarin Gaba ɗaya da kuma  Nazari na Haɗa-haɗa
Ba za a iya watsi da rashin daidaito na bugun zuciya ba a marasa lafiya da ke dauke da cutar coronavirus 2019 (COVID-19) domin yana da tasiri sosai akan sakamakon.
Don haka, wannan binciken ya yi niyyar gina hujjoji masu tabbas game da yawan kamuwa da cutar rashin daidaito na zuciya a marasa lafiyar COVID-19.
Mun gudanar da bincike na tsari don samun tushen bayanai/injina masu aminci,  ciki har da PubMed, Scopus, ɗakin karatu na Cochrane da kuma Web of Science.
Bayan dubawa, an fitar da bayanai masu muhimmanci kuma an tattara abubuwan da suka faru daga nazarin da aka haɗa don yin nazari na meta-analysis.
A ƙarshe, an haɗa nazarin tara a cikin nazarinmu, wanda ya ƙunshi marasa lafiya 1445.
Sakamakon binciken haɗa-haɗa ya nuna cewa yawan kamuwa da cutar arrhythmia a marasa lafiya masu cutar COVID-19 shine kashi 19.7% tare da kashi 95% na amincewa (CI) daga kashi 11.7 zuwa 27.6%.
Haka kuma akwai bambancin da ya yi yawa (I2□=□94.67%).
Matsalolin bugun zuciya sun yi yawa sosai a marasa lafiyar da ke dauke da cutar COVID-19 kuma an ga haka a cikin kashi 19.7% daga cikinsu.
Kyakkyawan bin diddigin ta hanyar electrocardiogram tare da gano matsalolin bugun zuciya daidai da wuri yana da muhimmanci don ingantaccen kulawa da sakamako.
Masu fama da cutar Covid-19 da yawa suna da bugawa mara kyau ta zuciya.
Masu bincike sun ce kimanin 1 cikin marasa lafiyar cutar Covid-19 5 suna fama da rashin daidaito na bugun zuciya, wanda kuma aka sani da bugun zuciya mara daidaito.

Domin yawan faruwarsa, sun ba da shawarar bin diddigin bugun zuciyar marasa lafiya ta amfani da na’ura mai suna electrocardiogram, domin likitoci su iya gano da kuma magance duk wata matsala ta bugun zuciya a matsayin farko.
Ko da yake cutar Covid-19 ta fi shafar huhu da tsarin numfashi, wasu bincike sun nuna cewa kuma za ta iya shafar zuciya.
Masu bincike sun so su sake duba bayanan marasa lafiya don ganin yawan matsalolin bugun zuciya a gaskiya a tsakanin marasa lafiyar cutar Covid-19 a shekarar 2020, kusa da farkon annobar duniya.
Sun gudanar da binciken hada-hada, wanda shine lokacin da masu bincike suka bincika nazarin daban-daban da yawa akan takamaiman batun don ƙoƙarin zana ƙarshen sakamako daga duk nazarin da aka haɗa.

Sun binciki nazarin da aka tantance ta hanyar takwarorinsu da sauran masu bincike suka yi a cikin manyan kundin bayanai, sannan suka fitar da duk wani bayani mai mahimmanci game da bugun zuciya mara kyau a marasa lafiyar cutar Covid-19.
A ƙarshe, sun haɗa nazarin 9 tare da bayanai game da marasa lafiya 1445.
Sun gano cewa an sami matsaloli na bugun zuciya a cikin kashi 19.7% na marasa lafiyar da ke dauke da cutar Covid-19.
Duk da haka, sun yi gargadi cewa ƙarancin nazarin da suka yi amfani da shi na iya raunana ƙarshen tunaninsu.
Wasu daga cikin nazarin kuma ba su bayyana ainihin matsalar zuciya ba, kuma iyakokin kowane nazari na iya rikitar da iyakokin nazari na haɗin gwiwar su.
Sun ba da shawara a nan gaba a binciki dalilin da ya sa yawancin marasa lafiya da ke dauke da cutar Covid-19 ke fama da rashin daidaito a bugun zuciya.
Marubutan wannan takarda sun fito daga Masar, duk da haka, marasa lafiyar da wannan bincike ya shafi sun fito daga China da Amurka.
Ra'ayoyin Sauran Masana Kimiyya kan Hijira, Lafiyar Kwakwalwa da PTSD:
Tacewar Littattafan da suka dace
A wannan babi, mun gabatar da bita kan nazarin kimiyya da aka gudanar kan PTSD, lafiyar kwakwalwa da walwala na 'yan ƙaura.
Yawancin bincike sun nuna cewa matsalolin da suka faru kafin da bayan hijira suna shafar lafiyar kwakwalwa da PTSD na 'yan gudun hijira da kuma 'yan ci-rani.
A ƙasashen asali, fuskantar cutarwa da azabtarwa sun haifar da haɗari masu yawa ga lafiyar kwakwalwar 'yan ƙaura.

Matsalolin kiwon lafiyar hankali da ke haifar da matsanancin kunci ga 'yan gudun hijira a ƙasashen da suka karɓe su sun haɗa da damuwa ta al'adu, matsayin doka, rabuwa da iyali, rashin fahimtar harshe, rashin samun damar yin amfani da ingantaccen kula da lafiya, nuna wariya, wariyar launin fata, ji na rashin taimako, raguwar girman kai, damuwa ta yau da kullun da kuma tsananin lura.
A cikin dukkan matsalolin lafiyar kwakwalwa, damuwa, tashin hankali da PTSD ana ɗaukar su a matsayin mafi yawa tare da adadin da ya yadu na 4–40%, 5–44% da 9–36%.
Gaba ɗaya, tallafin zamantakewa da hanyoyin magance matsaloli masu dacewa an gano su a matsayin masu hana.
Lafiyar kwakwalwar 'yan gudun hijira tana shafawa ta yanayin da suka bar a baya da kuma zamantakewa a sabon wuri.
Masu hijira da 'yan gudun hijira da ke tserewa zuwa ƙasashen waje sau da yawa suna fama da damuwa bayan tashin hankali da sauran matsalolin lafiyar kwakwalwa.

Ko da yake yawancin matsalolin nan sun samo asali ne daga abubuwan da suka faru a ƙasashen asalin su, masana kimiyya sun ce yana da muhimmanci a fahimci cewa damuwar rayuwa a sabuwar ƙasa na iya ƙara matsalar.

A cewar bincike da dama, damuwa, tashin hankali, da kuma cutar damuwa bayan tashin hankali (PTSD) dukkaninsu matsaloli ne na yau da kullun na lafiyar kwakwalwa a tsakanin 'yan ƙaura da 'yan gudun hijira.
PTSD yawanci sakamakon tsira daga abubuwan da ke haifar da hatsari ko barna ne, kuma mutane da yawa kan fuskanci tasirin wadannan abubuwan mara kyau na watanni, ko ma shekaru.
A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun so su fahimci abubuwan da suka bambanta da ke taka rawa a matsalolin lafiyar kwakwalwa na 'yan gudun hijira kamar PTSD.
Saboda haka, sun gudanar da irin wannan bincike da ake kira bita, inda suka tattara bayanai daga wasu bincike da dama kan wannan batu, domin gano yanayi ko abubuwa na gama gari.

A lokuta da dama, matsalolin kiwon lafiyar kwakwalwa na 'yan ƙaura sakamakon abubuwan da suka faru masu raɗaɗi ne kamar yaki, rasa mutanen da suke ƙauna, ko kuma dukan jiki da suka faru a ƙasashen haihuwarsu.
Lokacin da waɗannan mutanen suka bar waɗancan yanayi, sun fuskanci tafiye-tafiye masu wahala amma sai suka ji sauƙi lokacin da suka isa sabuwar ƙasa.
Duk da haka, masu binciken sun ce wannan sauƙin sau da yawa na ɗan lokaci ne, saboda 'yan ƙaura sun fuskanci sabbin kalubale bayan komawa.
Sun gano cewa baƙi yawanci suna fama da wahala a ƙasar sabuwa, musamman idan ba su fahimci harshen ba, ko kuma suna da wahalar daidaitawa da al'adun.
Lokacin da mutane suka shiga ƙasar ba bisa ka'ida ba, ko kuma suna ƙoƙarin neman mafaka, sai su kuma fuskanci matsaloli na shari'a, kuma sau da yawa suna da wahalar samun ayyuka kamar kiwon lafiya.
Ga wasu, wariya da nuna bambanci a ƙasar da suka ƙaura ya ƙara musu jin rashin tsaro, kuma da yawa sun bar ‘yan uwa a baya kuma suna kadai.
Wadannan abubuwan sun haifar da matsalolin lafiyar kwakwalwa na ci gaba, ko da bayan waɗannan 'yan gudun hijirar sun samu kwanciyar hankali fiye da na ƙasarsu.

Masu binciken sun ƙara da cewa, 'yan ƙaura sun yi amfani da dabarun da dama daban-daban wajen magance matsalolin, daga shirya yadda za su magance su a hankali, zuwa neman taimako daga wasu a cikin al'ummarsu, ko kuma hanyoyin da ba su da kyau kamar shan miyagun ƙwayoyi.
Masu binciken sun ce ana buƙatar ƙarin bincike a dukkan matakai na tafiyar 'yan ƙaura.
Musamman, yana da muhimmanci a bincika abubuwan da ke shafar lafiyar kwakwalwa a ƙasashen mutane, amma kuma a dogon lokaci a sabbin ƙasashen su.
Sun ƙara da cewa tafiyar mutane daga Afirka zuwa Turai tana buƙatar ƙarin kulawa daga masu bincike.
Wannan binciken hadin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya da ke zaune a Afirka ta Kudu da Jamus, kuma yana ɗaya daga cikin littattafai kan ƙwarewar 'yan ƙaura 'yan Afirka da ke zaune a ƙasashen Turai.
Kasancewa da Ɗorewar Amblyomma Hebraeum Sun Ƙara Nauyin Cutar Zuciya a Gundumar Kudu ta Botswana
Cututtukan zuciya cuta ce da aka samu ta hanyar kwari, wacce ke cutar da jini kuma tana da yuwuwar hana ci gaban harkokin noma a Botswana.
Wannan barazanar ga tsaron abinci na ƙasa ana danganta shi da karancin samarwa da mutuwar dabbobi a noma na manoma kanana fiye da na noma na kasuwanci.
Wannan binciken ya ba da ra'ayi game da nauyin cutar zuciya a Botswana.
An gano kwararan fari da ke ciyar da dabbobi a yankuna huɗu na kudancin Botswana ta hanyar bincike na siffar jiki da na ƙwayoyin halitta.
An yi hira da manoma game da yadda suke sarrafa cutar zuciya a cikin kananan hukumomin su.
An tattara rahotannin lamuran likitan dabbobi don tantance yawan lokuta a gundumar kudancin Botswana.

Sakamakon binciken ya bayyana; yaduwar Amblyomma hebraeum sosai a kananan hukumomi huɗu da aka yi nazari a kansu, ƙaruwar cutar zuciya a hankali a kowace shekara a ƙaramar hukumar Moshupa da kuma alamar ƙaruwar tasiri a kan nau'ikan tsuntsayen ƙasar gida duk da ƙoƙarin sarrafa kwari da kashi 63% na manoma da aka yi hira da su suka yi.

Amblyomma hebraeum, babban mai yada cutar Ehrlichia ruminantium a kudancin Afirka, ya yadu sosai a gundumar Kudancin Botswana, kuma hakan yana kawo cikas ga samar da kiwo a wannan gunduma, kuma watakila, a wasu wurare a ƙasar inda kwari ke cutar da dabbobi.
Don haka, akwai buƙatar sake duba hanyoyin da ake amfani da su wajen sarrafa kwari masu ɗauke da cututtuka tare da niyyar rage yawan cutar zuciya musamman a cikin tumaki da awaki.
Yawan dimbin kwari a kudancin Botswana ya kara dagula cutar zuciya a dabbobin gona.
Wannan binciken ya bayar da rahoton yawan cutar kunkuru da cutar zuciya a kudancin Botswana tsakanin shekarar 2017 zuwa 2019.
Sakamakon binciken zai iya taimaka wa gwamnati da manoma wajen yin tsare-tsare don sarrafa cutar zuciya sosai.
Wasu kwari masu tsotsa jini suna dauke da kwayar cuta mai suna Ehrlichia ruminantium, wacce ke haifar da wata cuta da aka sani da heartwater a cikin shanu, tumaki da awaki.
Wannan ƙwayar cuta ita ce kwari, ma’ana tana ci daga sauran halittu masu rai kamar dabbobi, tana musu illa.
Dabbobi masu fama da cutar zuciya yawanci suna da zafi mai tsanani, sun rasa sha'awar abinci, suna da matsalar numfashi, kuma daga karshe zasu iya mutuwa.
Cututtukan zuciya (Heartwater) ya yadu sosai a kudancin Botswana, kuma manoma a wannan yankin na rasa dabbobinsu saboda wannan cuta.
A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun bincika nauyin cutar zuciya a kudancin Botswana.
Sun fara tattara, ƙidaya da gano kwari daga shanu, tumaki da awaki don kwatanta adadin kwari masu dauke da ƙwayar cuta ta zuciya da sauran kwari.
Masu binciken sun kuma yi hira da wasu manoma game da abubuwan da suka faru da su game da cutar zuciya, kuma sun tattara wasu rahotannin cutar zuciya daga ofishin likitan dabbobi (lafiyar dabbobi).
Masu binciken sun ce kwari masu cutarwa sun yadu sosai a yankin da aka yi binciken, kuma adadin masu fama da cutar zuciya ya karu daga shekara zuwa shekara.
Sun tattara kwari 310 tsakanin shekarar 2017 zuwa 2019.
Sun gano nau'ikan tsutsotsi guda uku: tsutsotsin  kudu ta Afirka, tsutsotsin kafa-fari, da kuma tsutsotsin karen ruwan kasa.
Mafi yawancin shine kwari na Afirka ta Kudu (85%), kuma shi ne ke dauke da ƙwayoyin cuta da ke haifar da cutar zuciya.
Sauran nau'ikan kwari guda 2 da suka gano ba su da gudunmawa ga cutar zuciya, amma suna da alaƙa da wasu cututtukan dabbobi kamar 'theileriosis', 'anaplasmosis' da 'babesiosis'.
Wuraren da masu binciken suka yi nazari sun haɗa da Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa, da Jwaneng.
An fi samun kwari a Goodhope, Kanye da Moshupa.
Wannan yankin galibi yana da danshi, dutse kuma yana da ciyayi da yawa.
Jwaneng, wadda ke da maƙudan ƙarancin kwari, ta bushe sosai, kuma ƙasa ce mai yashi kuma ba ta da yawan tsire-tsire.
Masu binciken sun ce rikodin likitocin dabbobi sun bayyana jimillar lokuta 42 na cutar zuciya a Goodhope, 38 a Jwaneng, 75 a Kanye, da 146 a Moshupa, daga shekarar 2017 zuwa 2019.
Masu binciken sun ce cutar zuciya ta fi shafar awaki da shanu na gida fiye da na kasashen waje.
Sun ce manoma sun yi ƙoƙari don sarrafa kwari.
Alal misali, kashi 63% na manoma sun nutsar da dabbobi a cikin magungunan kashe kwari (sunadarai da ake amfani da su wajen kashe kwari kamar tik).
Kimanin ɓangare ɗaya bisa uku (30%) na manoma sun shafa mai ga dabbobi nasu domin sarrafa kwari, yayin da wasu (7%) suka koma gina sabbin gidajen dabbobi.

Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa kashi 44% na manoma ba su yi komai ba don magance dabbobi da ake zargin sun kamu da rashin lafiya, yayin da kashi 15% suka ce za su ziyarci jami’an likitan dabbobi don neman shawara, amma sun ba da magunguna ga dabbobi da kansu.
Ko da akwai allurar riga-kafi da za ta hana cutar zuciya, masu binciken sun ce kashi 93% na manoma ba su yi amfani da ita ba.
Manoman sun shaida wa masu bincike cewa dalilin shine saboda ba a yi musu karatu game da allurar riga-kafin ba, kuma saboda ba za su iya biyan kudin allurar riga-kafin ba.

Wasu nazarin da suka gabata sun kalli yadda aka rarraba kwari a Afirka, ciki har da Botswana, amma a cewar masu binciken, nasu shi ne na farko da ya kalli dangantakar da ke tsakanin kwari da cutar zuciya a Botswana.

Sun ce yawan cutar zuciya da likitocin dabbobi suka rubuta na iya zama ƙasa da yawan da manoma suka samu a zahiri, domin likitocin dabbobi yawanci suna gwada cutar zuciya ne kawai idan dabbobi sun mutu, ma’ana dabbobi masu fama da cutar ko wadanda suka warke ba koyaushe ake kiransu ba.
Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar cewa ya kamata a wayar da kan manoma kan yadda za su sarrafa da kuma kula da cutar zuciya a dabbobinsu, domin rage yaduwarta a yankin.
Sun kuma ce ya kamata a yi ƙarin bincike don sanin abubuwan da ke haifar da yawaitar kwari.
Masu binciken suna zaune a Botswana.
Manyan Abubuwan da ke Hana gwajin Lafiya kai tsaye a Indiya da Afirka ta Kudu

Ana ganin gwajin gaggawa (POC) a al'ummomi, gidaje, da kuma cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya na farko yana da damar da ta fi girma wajen rage jinkirin gano cututtuka da fara maganinsu kamar su HIV, tarin fuka, sifilis, da kuma maleriya.

Ganewar gaggawa da kuma yanke shawara kan hanyoyin magani na gaba da aka kammala a lokacin ziyarar likita ɗaya ko aƙalla a rana ɗaya, yayin da marar lafiyar ke jira, suna alkawarin shawo kan jinkirin da ke tattare da gwaje-gwajen da ake yi a dakin gwaje-gwaje na al'ada.
Amma, samun gwaje-gwaje masu arha, sauƙi, da sauri waɗanda za a iya gudanarwa a wajen dakunan gwaje-gwaje ba yana tabbatar da nasarar gwajin POC ba.

Don fahimtar sabbin ayyuka da kalubalen da na'urorin likita irin su ke fuskanta, sai mu yi nazari kan yadda ake amfani da kayan gwaji a wurin kula da marasa lafiya (POC) da kuma yadda aka haɗa su cikin tsarin aiki da hanyoyin kula da marasa lafiya.
Wannan babi ya yi bitar sakamakon da aka zaɓa daga aikin bincike na inganci game da cikas ga gwajin POC a Indiya da Afirka ta Kudu kuma ya tattauna su ta hanyar kwatanta.

Aikin ya yi amfani da tambayoyi masu rabin tsarin da tattaunawar ƙungiyoyin mayar da hankali don bincika hanyoyin ganewar asali a tsakanin manyan cututtuka da masu aiki a gidaje, asibitoci, al'ummomi, asibitoci, da dakunan gwaje-gwaje a Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya.
Idan aka kwatanta sakamakon da aka zaɓa, ya bayyana cewa ƙasashen biyu suna da tsarin bincike na daban-daban waɗanda ke samar da yanayi daban-daban na gwajin POC.
Sashen ya ƙare da tunani kan yadda za a yi la’akari da irin waɗannan fahimtoci lokacin tsara shirye-shiryen gwajin POC.
Rashin ingancin gwajin kiwon lafiya a wuraren kula da lafiya a Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya yana jinkirta kula da lafiya.
Nazarin kulawa kai tsaye (POC) yana nufin gwaje-gwajen kiwon lafiya da ake yi a wurin da marar lafiya ke samun kulawa, maimakon aika samfuran marasa lafiya zuwa dakin gwaje-gwaje don gwaji.
Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya ba sa samar da gwaje-gwaje masu sauri da inganci saboda rashin ingancin tsarin POC da dakunan gwaje-gwajen su.
Gwajin POC yana ba marasa lafiya damar samun damar yin gwaji da sauri tare da samun sakamako cikin gaggawa domin maganin cututtuka da kuma kula da su.
Wannan za a iya yi da na'urori masu sauƙi da arha waɗanda za su iya ba da sakamakon gwaji cikin sauri ba tare da ɗaukar samfuran zuwa dakunan gwaje-gwaje ba.
Amma akwai kalubale da yawa a POC waɗanda ke jinkirta kula da marasa lafiya a Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya.
Marubuta sun so su kwatanta gwajin POC a Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya domin su iya gano matsaloli.
Sun gudanar da tattaunawa da taron rukuni tare da ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya, marasa lafiya da kamfanonin kayan aikin likita daga watan Satumba, 2012, zuwa watan Yuni, 2013, a ƙasashen biyu.
Sun tambaya game da tsarin da matsalolin POC.

A fannin kiwon lafiyar jama'a, Indiya tana amfani da ɗumbin ƙananan dakunan gwaje-gwaje kuma suna yin gwaje-gwajen asali, amma ba a ba wa dakunan gwaje-gwajen su isasshen kuɗi ba, don haka ba su da kayan aiki masu yawa don yin gwaje-gwajen.
A sau da yawa ana gaya wa marasa lafiya su dawo wata rana ko su je wani wuri, wanda hakan ke haifar da matsaloli ga marasa lafiya.
Masu binciken sun kuma lura cewa wasu lokutan ana gwada marasa lafiya amma yana ɗaukar lokaci kafin sakamakon ya fito, kuma suna samun wahala wajen tuntubar likitansu bayan haka.
Masu halartar taron sun ce ya kamata a kara yawan dakunan gwaje-gwaje a asibitoci, kuma za a iya yin gwaje-gwaje a wurin da marasa lafiya ke shiga.
Sun kuma ce bin diddigin, magani ko shawara ya kamata su faru a wuri ɗaya.
A Afirka ta Kudu, sun gano cewa a fannin kiwon lafiya na jama'a, kamfani ɗaya ne ke kula da duk gwaje-gwajen, don haka samfuran suna zuwa wannan kamfani.
Ana yin wasu gwaje-gwaje masu sauƙi a wurin kulawa, kuma marasa lafiya suna samun sakamakon gaggawa.
Gwajin HIV da na TB suna ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo, don haka bin diddigin ko maganin kuma yana jinkiri.
Sauran jinkirin sun samo asali ne daga ɗaukar kaya, kuskuren rubuta sunayen marasa lafiya, kuskuren lakkafa samfurori, da kuma lalacewar tsarin kwamfuta.
Wajen gwajin HIV, wasu dakunan gwaje-gwaje sun yi amfani da hanyoyi daban-daban na gwaji, kuma wannan yana ba da sakamako marasa tabbas.

Sun gano cewa marasa lafiya suna ƙoƙarin yin gwajin HIV bisa ga nisan da ke tsakanin wurin da kuma irin gwajin, kuma saboda haka wasu lokutan suna amfani da katin shaida daban, wanda ke haifar da matsala lokacin ƙoƙarin yin taron bibiya.
Masu binciken sun ba da shawara cewa ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya dole ne su yi aiki tare don raba nauyin aiki.
Sun ce idan sabbin kayan gwajin HIV suka shigo, ya kamata a sake horar da ma’aikata kuma ya zama dole a sabunta tsarin.
Marubuta sun kwatanta bayanai daga ƙasashen biyu, kuma sun ba da shawara cewa hukumomi dole ne su binciki POC yadda ya kamata kafin ƙara sabbin samfura ko na'urori.
Sun kuma ce ya kamata a ƙara ƙoƙari wajen magance nauyin aiki a dakunan gwaje-gwaje da kuma fahimtar rawar da marasa lafiya ke takawa a kula da lafiyarsu.
Marubutan wannan takarda sun fito daga Afirka ta Kudu, Indiya, Kanada da Netherlands.
Dangane da ma'anar rashin lafiya mai tsanani da kulawa mai tsanani ta amfani da nazarin ra'ayi.
